description:
Return aggregate market context for a Spanish area: number of active
listings, median price, mean price, median €/m², and the count
broken down by bedroom band. Filterable by property type and search
type (for-sale / for-rent / holiday-rentals). Use this before
recommending a price or commenting on whether a listing is good
value.

If the place name is not one we hold, the response says so
(error: location_not_found, location_match.matched: false) and
returns no figures. Figures are NEVER nationwide fallbacks.

If several places share the name and one of them holds at least
80% of their live listings, the figures are for that place alone,
and location_match.other_places names the others (id, municipality,
province, listings). If the listings are split between them, or
none has any, the response says so (error: ambiguous_location,
location_match.ambiguous: true), lists them in
location_match.candidates and returns no figures. Either way, ask
again with the chosen id as location_id, or with the town or
province after a comma ('El Limonar, Mijas'). A town that holds no
area of that name is answered as location_not_found, with the
areas of that name we do hold in location_match.candidates.

Price figures follow the search type and are labelled with
price_unit: sale prices are totals, for-rent is per MONTH and
holiday-rentals is per WEEK. median_price_per_sqm is reported for
sales only.

The `oracle` block carries the attested transaction price for the
area. Check `oracle.verified` before citing it as verified: it is
true only for Spanish figures from the notarial register (Consejo
General del Notariado) with at least 10 recorded transactions
behind them. Outside Spain the figure comes from a national
house-price index, carries no transaction count, and must never be
described as notary-backed - `oracle.source` names the real source
and `oracle.note` says why it is not verified.

Transactions are recorded per municipality, so a sub-area
(Sotogrande, Puerto Banus, Nueva Andalucia, Orihuela Costa) is
answered with the figure for the municipality containing it, with
`oracle.rolled_up_from_sub_area` true and `oracle.municipality` /
`oracle.municipality_code` naming it. Quote it as the
municipality's figure, never as the sub-area's own.

Commercial property (property_types commercial, a family such as
offices, retail, cafes-bars-restaurants, hotels-leisure,
industrial-warehouses, garages-storage-rooms, buildings or
commercial-land, or one type such as shop) is answered with its
own figures: the ASKING prices of live commercial listings
(figures_basis asking_prices), per family, with the asking price
or monthly rent per m² and size bands, and no `oracle` block.
Below min_sample priced listings only the count is given. Homes
and commercial property are never summarised together.

location.description: Place name (city, suburb, or urbanisation). e.g. 'Marbella'. Add the town or province after a comma when several places share the name: 'El Limonar, Mijas'.

location_id.description: Area id from autocomplete_location or from location_match.candidates. Takes precedence over location.

property_types.description: Optional comma-separated slugs: apartments, villas, penthouses, plots, townhouses; or commercial, a commercial family (offices, retail, cafes-bars-restaurants, hotels-leisure, industrial-warehouses, garages-storage-rooms, buildings, commercial-land, businesses) or one commercial type (office, shop, bar, warehouse...).

tenure.description: Commercial sales only: traspaso narrows the figures to business transfers (the lease and the business taken over).

name: area_market_summary

median_rent_per_sqm.description: Commercial lettings: median monthly asking rent per m² of built area.

min_sample.description: Fewer priced listings than this and no median is given, only the count.

price_per_sqm.description: EUR per m². Verified only when `verified` is true; otherwise an estimate from the source in source_label.

verified_price_per_sqm.description: Deprecated: the same figure as price_per_sqm, under its old name. Despite the name it is verified only when `verified` is true.

title: Area market summary
